querystring.select: SELECT B.DESCR AS VendorCategory,A.IS_ACTIVE AS ActiveStatus, A.VENDOR_CODE AS BranchCode,A.TAX_ID_NO AS TaxNumber,A.VENDOR_NAME AS BranchName, C.DESCR AS BranchType
querystring.from: FROM dbo.VENDOR A WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.MR_VENDOR_CATEGORY_CODE = B.MASTER_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER C WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.MR_VENDOR_TYPE_CODE = C.MASTER_CODE
querystring.where: WHERE A.MR_VENDOR_CLASS = N'BRANCH' AND  VENDOR_ID = {0} AND B.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = N'VENDOR_CATEGORY' AND C.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = N'VENDOR_TYPE'
